note: The Juice Shop oracle: the polygon's known defects and the cells (account × endpoint × resource) that must produce a finding. Written by hand from the recon of 18 August 2026 (docs/polygons/juice-shop.md) and NOT taken from barbican's output: a reference generated by the program under test tests it for consistency with itself. The rationale — ADR-0009. `expectedCells` is 69: 3 accounts × (17 endpoints with no path parameter + products.read and product.reviews over one product + users.read over two users + basket.read over two baskets), the two writes being skipped before a request is built. Counted by hand and confirmed against --dry-run.
cellKey: account + endpoint + resource; resource = null on endpoints with no path parameters

admin-config-public.title: GET /rest/admin/application-configuration answers anybody, including a request with no token
admin-config-public.note: The application names the endpoint `admin` itself. The policy declares it closed to everyone: nothing here has an administrator role, so nothing is declared able to read it.

user-directory-open-to-customers.title: GET /api/Users returns every registered user with their email address to any logged-in customer
user-directory-open-to-customers.note: Measured: 25 records, the seeded users among them. A customer is not an administrator, and a directory of addresses is not a customer's to read. Anonymous gets 401 here, which is why this defect has two cells and not three.

profile-readable-by-number.title: GET /api/Users/{userId} serves another customer's profile to anyone logged in
profile-readable-by-number.note: BOLA inside one tenant. The policy allows the endpoint with scope own, so the cells where a customer reads their own profile agree and only the crossed pair is a finding.

basket-readable-by-number.title: GET /rest/basket/{basketId} serves another customer's basket to anyone logged in
basket-readable-by-number.note: Juice Shop's own challenge list calls this one View Basket. The basket id comes from the login response and is not the user id — 6 and 7 against users 25 and 26.

feedback-public.title: GET /api/Feedbacks answers a request with no token
feedback-public.note: Customer feedback, with the author attached. Public to everybody, so all three accounts produce a cell.

recycles-public.title: GET /api/Recycles answers a request with no token
recycles-public.note: Recycling requests carry the customer's address and pickup date.

stock-levels-public.title: GET /api/Quantitys answers a request with no token
stock-levels-public.note: Stock levels are the shop's own business, not the public's.

memories-public.title: GET /rest/memories answers a request with no token
memories-public.note: Photographs uploaded by customers, served to anybody who asks.

ftp-listing-public.title: GET /ftp serves a directory listing to anybody
ftp-listing-public.note: A file listing is not an endpoint a shop is meant to have at all; declared closed to everyone.

whoami-answers-anonymous.title: GET /rest/user/whoami answers 200 to a request with no token
whoami-answers-anonymous.note: The single cell of this defect, and the reason `whoami` is not the canary: an endpoint that answers the same to a valid token and to none cannot tell the two apart.

variants.note: One variant, and that is not an omission. Juice Shop has no vulnerability switch — the defects are what the application is for and are always on. ADR-0009 settled that the oracle is a hand-written list of defects rather than the difference between two modes, so a switch would have added nothing here anyway. The selector is empty: there is nothing to set.
